family.description: Anti-lipopolysaccharide factor binds to bacterial LPS and may specifically inhibit the LPS-mediated activation of the hemolymph coagulation. It has a strong antibacterial effect, especially on the growth of Gram-negative bacteria [[cite:PUB00056151],[cite:PUB00056152]]. This entry also includes the antibacterial protein Scygonadin, which has antibacterial activity against the Gram-positive bacterium Micrococcus luteus [[cite:PUB00056153]].
family.name: Anti-lipopolysaccharide factor/Scygonadin
